sloka: श्रूयताम् सर्वम् आख्यास्ये दुर्ग कर्म विधानतः ।गुप्ता पुरी यथा लंका रक्षिता च यथा बलैः ॥६-३-७॥।।
transliteration: śrūyatām sarvam ākhyāsye durga karma vidhānataḥ ।guptā purī yathā laṁkā rakṣitā ca yathā balaiḥ ॥6-3-7॥।।

translations.english: "I will relate the way in which the city of Lanka is fortified, the way in which it is protected by secret forces, everything you wish to hear."
